fields.statement: Verified at 91caa11e. go test -trimpath ./internal/api/... passed, including the parseFailedTests test in ship_test.go: a nested TestScripts/review-check-worktree failure gives TestScripts and TestScripts/review-check-worktree, two failures in one package give TestA and TestB, and an infra-only log gives none. go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/(run-ship|ship-check-ci-test-findings|describe-golden)' -v passed all 14 scripts. ship-check-ci-test-findings.txtar uses a fake gh whose check fails again after its rerun and whose 'run view 42 --log-failed' prints '--- FAIL: TestScripts/x'. ship check --settled --json lists TestScripts/x under tests and findings and records ci_findings in the state file. With an infra-only log the test is a plain failure and ci_findings is cleared, and a green check clears it too. This fixes attempt 1's stale-findings finding. I read the diff in internal/api/ship.go: shipReadFailures replaces st.CIFindings on each read and clears it for a head that was not rerun, shipRerunFailed clears it on a new rerun, and the green branch clears it. Note: the acceptance's -run 'TestScripts/run-ship' pattern does not match the script's name, so I ran it by name.
